title: Folding of FluoroCubes
author: Stefan Niekamp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8k2huye

steps.title: Select fluorophore dye
steps.instruction: Choose a dye for the six‑dye FluoroCube; tested options are ATTO 488, ATTO 565, ATTO 647N, Cy3, Cy3N (sulfonated Cy3), and Cy5. ATTO 647N and Cy3N are recommended based on performance.

steps.title: Order modified oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Order the required dye‑modified oligos from a synthesis provider, noting that linker length and attachment chemistry may affect performance. Consult Supplementary Table 1 for manufacturers and Supplementary Table 2 for the specific sequences needed for the chosen FluoroCube design.

steps.title: Prepare oligo stock solutions
steps.instruction: Resuspend each oligonucleotide in deionized water to a final concentration of 100 µM, aliquot 5 µl portions, and store the aliquots at –20 °C.

steps.title: Assemble folding reaction
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 5 µl of each of the four required oligos (giving 10 µM final per oligo), add 25 µl deionized water, and add 5 µl of 10× folding buffer (50 mM Tris, pH 8.5, 10 mM EDTA, 400 mM MgCl₂). Total volume = 50 µl.

steps.title: Run thermocycler folding program
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a thermocycler and execute the following temperature ramp (≈15 h total): 85 °C for 5 min; cool from 80 °C to 65 °C decreasing 1 °C every 5 min; then cool from 65 °C to 25 °C decreasing 1 °C every 20 min; finally hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perform agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2.0 % agarose gel in TBE buffer (45 mM Tris‑borate, 1 mM EDTA) supplemented with 12 mM MgCl₂. Run the folding reaction sample at 70 V for 3 h with the gel box placed in an ice bath. Do not add any DNA‑binding stain such as ethidium bromide.

steps.title: Image gel
steps.instruction: Visualize the gel using a multicolor gel imager (e.g., Typhoon scanner) to locate the desired band, which is typically the top band.

steps.title: Extract and purify FluoroCubes
steps.instruction: Excise the target band with a razor blade, place the gel slice into a Freeze ’N Squeeze column (BioRad 732‑6165), and centrifuge for 3 min at 12,000 rcf at 4 °C. Collect the flow‑through; it contains the purified FluoroCubes.

steps.title: Store purified FluoroCubes
steps.instruction: Store the purified FluoroCubes at 4 °C; they remain stable for a couple of weeks.
